tables.name: core.organisations
tables.purpose: IAA, partners, DISCOMs, FPOs, developers and agencies; organisation type is governed vocabulary.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: auth.users
tables.purpose: Identity provider account; no plaintext passwords or browser role switch.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: auth.roles
tables.purpose: Approved role catalogue.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: auth.permissions
tables.purpose: Action-level permission catalogue.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: auth.role_permissions
tables.purpose: Actions granted to a role.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
role_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.roles(id)
permission_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.permissions(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: auth.user_roles
tables.purpose: Organisation-scoped or platform-scoped role assignment; not project membership.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id)
role_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.roles(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: core.units
tables.purpose: Controlled units with dimension; crop-dependent bale conversion is not a universal unit factor.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: core.seasons
tables.purpose: Kharif, Rabi, Summer/Zaid and explicit annual-total category.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
is_total boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: core.crops
tables.purpose: Crops AND source aggregate categories; aggregates must not be added to components.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
is_aggregate boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: core.models
tables.purpose: Configurable agrivoltaics models, system typologies and ownership models distinguished by kind.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
kind text NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('agrivoltaics','system_typology','land_ownership','project_ownership'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: core.practices
tables.purpose: Agronomic, irrigation, water, soil, biodiversity and land restoration practices.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: core.locales
tables.purpose: Approved languages.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
is_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: core.translations
tables.purpose: UI and controlled vocabulary translations; translation keys stable across releases.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
locale_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.locales(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: geo.areas
tables.purpose: Stable geography identifiers; preserve historical administrative identities.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
level text NOT NULL CHECK(level IN ('country','state','district','subdistrict','village','city'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
constraints: CHECK(valid_to IS NULL OR valid_from IS NULL OR valid_to>=valid_from)

tables.name: geo.aliases
tables.purpose: Source-specific names and approved geography matches; historical names not silently rewritten.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
area_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo.areas(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: geo.area_crosswalks
tables.purpose: Split/merge relationships between historical and new areas; weights require approved method.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
from_area_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo.areas(id)
to_area_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo.areas(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: data.sources
tables.purpose: Original provider, licence, access and source location.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: data.datasets
tables.purpose: Thematic catalogue independent of physical tables.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
source_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.sources(id)
domain_no smallint NOT NULL CHECK(domain_no BETWEEN 1 AND 10)
is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: data.files
tables.purpose: Object-store metadata for original files, GIS assets, photos, DPRs and generated reports.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
scan_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(scan_status IN ('pending','clean','rejected'))
access_class text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'restricted' CHECK(access_class IN ('public','restricted'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: data.dataset_versions
tables.purpose: Immutable released source snapshot; public rights and analytical approval are separate.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
dataset_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.datasets(id)
received_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK(status IN ('draft','review','approved','rejected','retired'))
is_demo boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
is_current boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
public_allowed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
planning_allowed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
export_allowed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
constraints: CHECK(reference_end IS NULL OR reference_start IS NULL OR reference_end>=reference_start)
CHECK(status<>'approved' OR (approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL))

tables.name: data.coverage
tables.purpose: Coverage register, including missing or stale data for the two selected pilot districts.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
dataset_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.datasets(id)
area_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo.areas(id)
coverage_status text NOT NULL CHECK(coverage_status IN ('missing','partial','available','stale','blocked'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: data.dataset_grants
tables.purpose: Restricted partner access to named datasets; default deny.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
dataset_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.datasets(id)
organisation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.organisations(id)
can_read boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
can_import boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
can_export boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: data.import_jobs
tables.purpose: One reproducible import attempt: hash, parser version and mapping version.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.dataset_versions(id)
started_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: data.source_records
tables.purpose: Every original row preserved by ordinal; repeated Excel headers preserved as arrays.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
import_job_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.import_jobs(id)
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'staged' CHECK(status IN ('staged','accepted','quarantined','excluded'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: data.quality_issues
tables.purpose: Row/field-level unresolved and resolved issues; source rows never deleted to hide discrepancies.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
source_record_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.source_records(id)
severity text NOT NULL CHECK(severity IN ('info','warning','error'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: data.collection_tasks
tables.purpose: 100 source collection tracker tasks in the WP1 code; workflow not fixed to those 100.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
area_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo.areas(id)
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_started' CHECK(status IN ('not_started','requested','in_progress','received','validated','blocked'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: geo.boundaries
tables.purpose: Versioned polygons; a geography may have several historical boundaries.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
area_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo.areas(id)
dataset_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.dataset_versions(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: geo.layers
tables.purpose: Version-bound layer style, legend and vector/raster source; raster bytes remain in object storage.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
dataset_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.dataset_versions(id)
layer_type text NOT NULL CHECK(layer_type IN ('vector','raster','table'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: geo.features
tables.purpose: Generic imported GIS features for overlays; domain facts use typed tables.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
layer_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo.layers(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: geo.geocoding_reviews
tables.purpose: Geocode candidates, accuracy and accepted coordinates; city centroids are not facility locations.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
source_record_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.source_records(id)
accuracy_class text NOT NULL CHECK(accuracy_class IN ('facility','parcel','street','city','district','unknown'))
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(status IN ('pending','accepted','rejected'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: wp1.land_statistics
tables.purpose: Source district-year statistical rows; retain original totals; units not inferred from filename.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
dataset_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.dataset_versions(id)
area_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo.areas(id)
row_kind text NOT NULL CHECK(row_kind IN ('district','state_total'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: wp1.crop_production
tables.purpose: Long-format production; no district yield may be inferred from this national series.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
dataset_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.dataset_versions(id)
area_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo.areas(id)
crop_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.crops(id)
season_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.seasons(id)
unit_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.units(id)
value_status text NOT NULL CHECK(value_status IN ('numeric','included_in_rabi','included_in_kharif','not_reported','non_numeric'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
constraints: CHECK((value_status='numeric' AND production IS NOT NULL) OR (value_status<>'numeric' AND production IS NULL))

tables.name: wp1.facilities
tables.purpose: Stable identity of mandis, cold stores, dairies, FPO hubs, fodder units and processors.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: wp1.facility_versions
tables.purpose: Facility observations including unknown coordinates and source area strings.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
dataset_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.dataset_versions(id)
facility_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES wp1.facilities(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: wp1.cold_chain_projects
tables.purpose: Government cold-chain programme projects, NOT AgriPV projects; may map to multiple facilities.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
dataset_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.dataset_versions(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: wp1.cold_chain_facilities
tables.purpose: Verified programme-project to physical-facility mapping; do not assume one project is one facility.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
cold_chain_project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES wp1.cold_chain_projects(id)
facility_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES wp1.facilities(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: wp1.substations
tables.purpose: Stable grid asset identity.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: wp1.substation_versions
tables.purpose: Time-bound substation location, voltage and loading observations.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
dataset_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.dataset_versions(id)
substation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES wp1.substations(id)
area_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo.areas(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: wp1.feeders
tables.purpose: Stable feeder identity; partner IDs are DISCOM scoped.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
discom_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.organisations(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: wp1.feeder_versions
tables.purpose: Feeder topology, capacity and reliability with period and method.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
dataset_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.dataset_versions(id)
feeder_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES wp1.feeders(id)
area_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo.areas(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: wp1.feeder_load_readings
tables.purpose: Timestamped load curves required for grid assessment.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
dataset_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.dataset_versions(id)
feeder_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES wp1.feeders(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: wp1.solar_installations
tables.purpose: Stable existing solar plants, parks and RE clusters for retrofit screening.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: wp1.solar_installation_versions
tables.purpose: Observed solar layout and retrofit inputs.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
dataset_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.dataset_versions(id)
installation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES wp1.solar_installations(id)
area_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo.areas(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: wp1.environment_observations
tables.purpose: Solar resource, rainfall, temperature, livestock and fodder district statistics with explicit grain.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
dataset_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.dataset_versions(id)
area_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo.areas(id)
unit_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.units(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: wp1.agro_zones
tables.purpose: Agro-climatic zone polygons and descriptive bands.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
dataset_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.dataset_versions(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: wp1.crop_suitability
tables.purpose: Crop/season/zone shade tolerance and calendars; source-backed rules, not sample thresholds.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
dataset_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.dataset_versions(id)
crop_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.crops(id)
season_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.seasons(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: wp1.irrigation_statistics
tables.purpose: Actual irrigation method/source data when supplied; not populated from the misnamed length workbook.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
dataset_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.dataset_versions(id)
area_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo.areas(id)
unit_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.units(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: wp1.land_parcels
tables.purpose: Parcel boundaries and physical constraints required for site-level screening.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
dataset_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.dataset_versions(id)
area_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo.areas(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: content.resources
tables.purpose: Stable publication/handbook/case study/advisory identity.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: content.resource_versions
tables.purpose: Translated, versioned reviewed knowledge content.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
dataset_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.dataset_versions(id)
resource_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES content.resources(id)
locale_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.locales(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: content.resource_areas
tables.purpose: Regional resource linkage.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
resource_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES content.resources(id)
area_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo.areas(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: content.policies
tables.purpose: Stable policy/scheme identity.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
kind text NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('policy','scheme'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: content.policy_versions
tables.purpose: Effective policy text and structured eligibility; never imply automatic entitlement.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
dataset_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.dataset_versions(id)
policy_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES content.policies(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
constraints: CHECK(effective_to IS NULL OR effective_from IS NULL OR effective_to>=effective_from)

tables.name: content.policy_areas
tables.purpose: Geographic applicability and convergence overlays.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
policy_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES content.policy_versions(id)
area_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo.areas(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: content.queries
tables.purpose: Implementer questions with restricted author identity and region; publication is separately curated.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
asked_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: content.query_responses
tables.purpose: Reviewer answers; published learning is linked to a reviewed resource.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
query_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES content.queries(id)
author_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: project.projects
tables.purpose: One permanent AgriPV project ID across WP1, WP2 and WP3.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
owner_organisation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.organisations(id)
created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id)
is_demo boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: project.versions
tables.purpose: Immutable approved project profile; changing capacity cannot rewrite historic monitoring.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES project.projects(id)
area_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo.areas(id)
status text NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('planned','pilot','construction','operational','inactive','closed'))
review_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK(review_status IN ('draft','submitted','returned','approved','rejected'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
constraints: CHECK(cultivated_area_ha IS NULL OR site_area_ha IS NULL OR cultivated_area_ha<=site_area_ha)
CHECK(agripv_footprint_ha IS NULL OR site_area_ha IS NULL OR agripv_footprint_ha<=site_area_ha)
CHECK(review_status<>'approved' OR (approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL))

tables.name: project.memberships
tables.purpose: Project-level user assignment independent of organisation-wide roles.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES project.projects(id)
user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id)
role_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.roles(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: project.partners
tables.purpose: Multiple EPCs, research partners, developers and O&M partners per version.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
project_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES project.versions(id)
organisation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.organisations(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: project.contacts
tables.purpose: Restricted land-owner and DISCOM contact data; excluded from public profiles.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES project.projects(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: project.land_uses
tables.purpose: Area breakdowns retain overlap groups: solar footprint overlaps cultivated area.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
project_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES project.versions(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: project.designs
tables.purpose: Typed structural fields from WP1; separate units for DC, AC, modules and clearance.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
project_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES project.versions(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: project.grid_connections
tables.purpose: Actual approved connection, distinct from nearest substation distance.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
project_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES project.versions(id)
discom_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.organisations(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: project.crop_plans
tables.purpose: Multiple crops and seasons rather than a single crop text on project.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
project_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES project.versions(id)
crop_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.crops(id)
season_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.seasons(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: project.profile_notes
tables.purpose: Governed narrative fields from the 74-field template; measurable facts live in typed tables.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
project_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES project.versions(id)
visibility text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'restricted' CHECK(visibility IN ('public','restricted'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: project.documents
tables.purpose: DPRs, lease evidence, photos and design drawings tied to the correct profile revision.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
project_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES project.versions(id)
file_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.files(id)
public_allowed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: project.publications
tables.purpose: Explicit public release of an approved project version and a field whitelist.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
project_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES project.versions(id)
approved_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: plan.methods
tables.purpose: Stable named analytical method, including shading and financial worksheet if approved.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
function_code text NOT NULL CHECK(function_code IN ('suitability','grid','model','market','scheme','retrofit','shading','finance','monitoring'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: plan.method_versions
tables.purpose: Versioned approved algorithm and code artifact hash; no invented production formulas.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
method_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.methods(id)
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK(status IN ('draft','approved','retired'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
constraints: CHECK(status<>'approved' OR (approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL))

tables.name: plan.criteria
tables.purpose: Approved normalisation, weights, exclusion rules and missing-data treatment.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
method_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.method_versions(id)
missing_action text NOT NULL CHECK(missing_action IN ('withhold','flag','approved_renormalisation'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: plan.assessments
tables.purpose: Open-access planning case; login optional, anonymous access token stored as hash.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
area_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES geo.areas(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: plan.scenarios
tables.purpose: Editable scenario; a run freezes the scenario revision.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
assessment_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.assessments(id)
revision integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: plan.runs
tables.purpose: Immutable execution snapshot; replay uses pinned versions and exact input payload.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
scenario_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.scenarios(id)
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued' CHECK(status IN ('queued','running','completed','partial','failed'))
is_demo boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: plan.run_datasets
tables.purpose: Every dataset version and boundary version consumed by a run.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
run_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.runs(id)
dataset_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.dataset_versions(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: plan.run_methods
tables.purpose: Method versions pinned separately for all six planning functions.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
run_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.runs(id)
method_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.method_versions(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: plan.results
tables.purpose: Six domain outputs with explicit unavailable/indicative status; structured result payloads validated per method.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
run_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.runs(id)
method_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.method_versions(id)
status text NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('computed','indicative','cannot_assess','failed'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: plan.criterion_results
tables.purpose: Explainable MCDA contributions; source row and raw value retained.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
run_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.runs(id)
criterion_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.criteria(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: plan.gaps
tables.purpose: Missing, outdated, restricted or coarse evidence; not silently zero-filled.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
run_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.runs(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: plan.market_results
tables.purpose: Facility distance/travel-time per run, not a permanent facility property.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
run_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.runs(id)
facility_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES wp1.facility_versions(id)
distance_method text NOT NULL CHECK(distance_method IN ('straight_line','road_network'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: plan.model_results
tables.purpose: Ranked model recommendations with crop and evidence explanation.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
run_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.runs(id)
model_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.models(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: plan.scheme_results
tables.purpose: Potential scheme match uses exact effective policy version; final eligibility not promised.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
run_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.runs(id)
policy_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES content.policy_versions(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: plan.retrofit_checks
tables.purpose: One row per physical/land-rights/grid/agricultural retrofit check.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
run_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.runs(id)
status text NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pass','fail','unknown','field_verification'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: plan.shading_runs
tables.purpose: Versioned optional shading analysis reused by WP1 and WP2; configuration and output are immutable.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
run_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.runs(id)
method_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.method_versions(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: plan.reports
tables.purpose: Export freezes one coherent run, its template, locale and checksum.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
run_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.runs(id)
file_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.files(id)
locale_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.locales(id)
generated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
access_class text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'restricted' CHECK(access_class IN ('public','restricted'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: plan.project_handoffs
tables.purpose: Explicit reviewed conversion to a registered project; a scenario is never itself a project.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
assessment_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.assessments(id)
run_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.runs(id)
project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES project.projects(id)
approved_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.periods
tables.purpose: Explicit date ranges and period grain; quarterly and seasonal totals must not be summed together.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
kind text NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('quarterly','seasonal','annual','monthly'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.indicators
tables.purpose: Stable indicator codes, domains and aggregation semantics.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
domain text NOT NULL CHECK(domain IN ('energy','agriculture','income','land','nature','inclusion','progress'))
aggregation text NOT NULL CHECK(aggregation IN ('sum','weighted_ratio','latest','distinct_count','non_additive'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.indicator_versions
tables.purpose: Immutable unit, validation and calculation definition.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
indicator_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.indicators(id)
value_type text NOT NULL CHECK(value_type IN ('number','text','boolean','date','choice','json'))
is_sensitive boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.form_versions
tables.purpose: Configurable seven-section monitoring form, frozen per reporting obligation.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK(status IN ('draft','approved','retired'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.form_fields
tables.purpose: Indicator mapping with conditions and repeat-group definition; no app rebuild for new indicators.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
form_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.form_versions(id)
indicator_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.indicator_versions(id)
required boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.obligations
tables.purpose: Expected project-period-form return including due date and assignment.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES project.projects(id)
period_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.periods(id)
form_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.form_versions(id)
assigned_to uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.submissions
tables.purpose: Logical return identity; one per obligation, with many immutable submitted revisions.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
obligation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.obligations(id)
project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES project.projects(id)
created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.submission_versions
tables.purpose: Correction history and pinned project capacity/area. Submit seals payload; correction creates next version.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
submission_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.submissions(id)
project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES project.projects(id)
project_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES project.versions(id)
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK(status IN ('draft','submitted','returned','approved','rejected','superseded'))
validation_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(validation_status IN ('pending','passed','failed'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
constraints: CHECK(status NOT IN ('submitted','returned','approved','rejected','superseded') OR (submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND submitted_by IS NOT NULL AND payload_hash IS NOT NULL))
CHECK(status<>'approved' OR (validation_status='passed' AND approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL))

tables.name: mon.indicator_values
tables.purpose: Configurable extra responses; typed analytical facts below are authoritative for their indicator codes.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
submission_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.submission_versions(id)
indicator_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.indicator_versions(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
constraints: CHECK(num_nonnulls(value_number,value_text,value_boolean,value_date,value_json)=1 OR (num_nonnulls(value_number,value_text,value_boolean,value_date,value_json)=0 AND missing_reason IS NOT NULL))

tables.name: mon.energy_records
tables.purpose: Generation segments permit capacity changes within a reporting period; denominator defined by approved CUF method.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
submission_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.submission_versions(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.baselines
tables.purpose: Matched crop-season plot baseline/control with source; national production totals are not baselines.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES project.projects(id)
crop_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.crops(id)
period_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.periods(id)
method_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.method_versions(id)
baseline_type text NOT NULL CHECK(baseline_type IN ('control_plot','regional','historical'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.harvest_records
tables.purpose: Repeatable crop/plot/season actual harvest with matched comparator.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
submission_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.submission_versions(id)
crop_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.crops(id)
season_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.seasons(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.beneficiaries
tables.purpose: Pseudonymous person IDs for distinct participation, separate from household count.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
organisation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.organisations(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.beneficiary_private
tables.purpose: Optional encrypted PII, separated from analytics and public publication.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
beneficiary_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.beneficiaries(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.project_beneficiaries
tables.purpose: Many-to-many project participation with start/end and role.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES project.projects(id)
beneficiary_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.beneficiaries(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.participation_records
tables.purpose: Person-level period participation enables distinct counts; age/youth is period-specific.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
submission_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.submission_versions(id)
beneficiary_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.beneficiaries(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.inclusion_totals
tables.purpose: Aggregate-only alternative when person data is unavailable; do not combine with person totals.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
submission_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.submission_versions(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.income_records
tables.purpose: Income/receipts at declared project, FPO or household grain; transfer flows kept distinct.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
submission_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.submission_versions(id)
scope_kind text NOT NULL CHECK(scope_kind IN ('project','fpo','household'))
accounting_basis text NOT NULL CHECK(accounting_basis IN ('gross_receipt','expense','net_income','transfer'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.land_records
tables.purpose: Land denominators and water inputs used in dual productivity; overlaps not blindly summed.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
submission_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.submission_versions(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.practice_records
tables.purpose: Nature-positive adoption and measured sustainability inputs.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
submission_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.submission_versions(id)
practice_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.practices(id)
adoption_status text NOT NULL CHECK(adoption_status IN ('adopted','not_adopted','unknown','not_applicable'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.scheme_linkages
tables.purpose: Actual programme linkage distinct from WP2 possible eligibility.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
submission_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.submission_versions(id)
policy_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES content.policy_versions(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.progress_records
tables.purpose: Implementation milestones and physical completion.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
submission_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.submission_versions(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.evidence
tables.purpose: Evidence linked to return revision and indicator/record path; mandatory evidence checked on submit.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
submission_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.submission_versions(id)
file_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES data.files(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.validation_results
tables.purpose: Validation rule outcomes pinned to submitted payload hash.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
submission_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.submission_versions(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.review_events
tables.purpose: Append-only review actions and correction reasons; reviewer distinct from submitter unless explicitly permitted.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
submission_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.submission_versions(id)
actor_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id)
action text NOT NULL CHECK(action IN ('submit','return','resubmit','approve','reject','revoke','supersede'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
constraints: CHECK(action NOT IN ('return','reject','revoke') OR (reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(reason))>0))

tables.name: mon.calculated_metrics
tables.purpose: Approved calculation outputs retain numerator/denominator/method; weighted portfolio ratios recomputed.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
submission_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.submission_versions(id)
indicator_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.indicator_versions(id)
method_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan.method_versions(id)
status text NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('computed','cannot_assess'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: mon.releases
tables.purpose: Separate approval from publication: authorised analytics or explicitly redacted public aggregate.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
submission_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES mon.submission_versions(id)
approved_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id)
audience text NOT NULL CHECK(audience IN ('authorised','public_aggregate'))
released_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: ops.audit_events
tables.purpose: Append-only operational audit; opaque target is intentional, not a domain relationship.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: ops.notifications
tables.purpose: Reminder outbox with deduplication, retry state and delivery tracking.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
recipient_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id)
channel text NOT NULL CHECK(channel IN ('email','in_app'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tables.name: ops.jobs
tables.purpose: Asynchronous ingestion, GIS, planning and export job execution metadata.
columns: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
